The '''Hune sector''' was a [[Mid Rim Territories]] [[sector]]. It was the location of the [[Al'doleem system]], containing the [[Water|river]] [[moon]] of [[Al'doleem]], and the [[Sinta system]], containing the [[Sinta Glacier]] [[Water|ice]] [[asteroid]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
